description.value: Dudes Coffee House is a local, family-run café in South Surrey opened in 2015 by Kelly and Larry Kristof. The shop roasts and brews specialty coffee and serves an all-day breakfast and lunch menu, house-made baked goods, and weekend brunch with Dim Sum on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays. It sits in a small strip-unit setting on Crescent Road, making it a convenient stop for cyclists exploring the South Surrey area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Dudes Coffee House is a real, operating family-run café at 12823 Crescent Rd, Surrey, BC V4P 1J6, serving coffee, brunch, baked goods, and a full breakfast/lunch menu. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. Two different phone numbers appear on the website — 604-385-1667 in the header and 604-531-4667 on the Locations page — which is flagged as a concern; the Locations page number is used as it is tied to the physical address.
